column1: Prepare these files before testing uploads. Use sample images only. The size limit is 5 MB, which is 5,120 KB or 5,242,880 bytes. Copy every file to the test phone before testing: PDFs and other documents to Files / Downloads, and images to Photos (gallery) so they can be picked from either place.

column5: Compressed to 5 MB or less and accepted, or rejected with a size message (M7)
